steuer_eigen.title: Tax cockpit (Schedule V)
steuer_eigen.disclaimer: Overview for preparation purposes, not tax advice. Please have a tax advisor verify. Maintenance costs are aggregated automatically from documents typed as "Reparatur/Erhaltung" with a stored amount and a receipt date within the selected tax year.
steuer_eigen.boden_gleich_gebaeude: Equals a building share of {{wert}}%. The same value is shown under Edit in the tax data.
steuer_eigen.hausgeld_gleich_euro: Equals €{{euro}} per month of a €{{gesamt}} service charge. The same value is shown under Edit in the tax data.
steuer_eigen.monate_angenommen: The first rental income is not recorded, 12 rented months are assumed. You can maintain the date in the investment under milestones.
steuer_eigen.miteigentum_hinweis: All items are calculated proportionally with a co-ownership share of {{wert}}%.
steuer_eigen.erhaltung_belege: Maintenance costs {{jahr}}: total of recorded receipts with an amount ({{count}}). Receipts without an amount do not count.
steuer_eigen.hausgeld_hint: Only the administration share is deductible. Contributions to the maintenance reserve are not deductible expenses. Without this input the item is not applied.
steuer_eigen.method_hint_zve: Tax effect using the difference method: income tax with and without this property (§ 32a EStG). Your taxable income is derived from your self-disclosure (gross times 0.7). The effective rate is therefore usually below your marginal rate.
steuer_eigen.method_hint_zve_angegeben: Tax effect using the difference method: income tax with and without this property (§ 32a EStG). Your taxable income is taken from your self-disclosure. The effective rate is therefore usually below your marginal rate.
steuer_eigen.method_hint_flat: The tax effect is calculated flat with your entered marginal rate, your taxable income is unknown. Therefore only an estimate.
steuer_eigen.boden_hint: Without this input no depreciation is calculated.
steuer_eigen.satz_hint: Without this input (or a self-disclosure) no tax effect is calculated.
steuer_eigen.missing_intro_one: Result incomplete, one input is missing:
steuer_eigen.method_hint_missing: Without a marginal rate or self-disclosure no tax effect is calculated, no default rate is applied.
steuer_eigen.stift_gemeinsam: The same value as under Edit on the property.
steuer_eigen.hausgeld_ohne_gesamt: Without a monthly service charge the share cannot be converted into euros. Enter the service charge under Edit.
steuer_eigen.prozent_ungueltig: Please enter a value between 0 and 100.
steuer_eigen.hinweis_miete: From the net cold rent, edit under Edit
steuer_eigen.hinweis_schuldzinsen: From loan and interest rate, edit under Edit
steuer_eigen.hinweis_erhaltung: Sum of receipts, add a receipt under Documents
steuer_eigen.monate_angenommen_kurz: The first rental income is not recorded, 12 rented months are assumed.
steuer_eigen.erste_miete_hilfe: Rental income counts from this month in the tax year. The date also appears under milestones.

posten.miete: Rental income (net cold rent × {{monate}} months) · Section 21 EStG
posten.umlagen: Collected utility prepayments (× {{monate}} months) · Section 21 EStG
posten.umlagen_fehlt: Collected utility prepayments · Section 21 EStG: missing
posten.afa_fehlt: Building depreciation (AfA) · Section 7 (4) EStG: missing (building share, year of construction or depreciation rate)
posten.hausgeld_nicht_umlage: Non-recoverable share of the service charge (excluding the maintenance reserve contribution)
posten.hausgeld_nicht_umlage_fehlt: Non-recoverable share of the service charge: missing (the maintenance reserve contribution is not deductible)
posten.hausgeld_umlagefaehig: Recoverable operating costs (service charge minus the non-recoverable share)
posten.hausgeld_umlagefaehig_fehlt: Recoverable operating costs: not applied because the collected utility prepayments are missing
posten.erhaltung: Maintenance expenses (Erhaltungsaufwand) (total of recorded receipts) · Section 9 EStG

fehlt.umlagen: Collected utility prepayments missing (enter the tenant’s utility prepayments), income not applied
fehlt.nebenkosten: Incidental purchase costs not recorded, the depreciation base only contains the purchase price
fehlt.gebaeudeanteil: Building share missing (enter it in the tax data or as a land value share), depreciation not calculated
fehlt.afa_satz: Year of construction and depreciation rate missing, the rate under Section 7 (4) EStG cannot be determined, depreciation not calculated
fehlt.hausgeld: Administration share of the service charge missing (enter euros per month in the tax data or a percentage), service charge item not applied
fehlt.grundsteuer: Property tax missing, item not applied
fehlt.verwaltung: Administration costs missing, item not applied
fehlt.steuersatz: Tax rate missing (enter your marginal tax rate or complete the self-disclosure), tax effect not calculated
fehlt.sonderafa_grundlage: Special depreciation under Section 7b EStG not applied: the depreciation base is incomplete (building share or year of construction missing).
fehlt.sonderafa_zeitraum: Special depreciation under Section 7b EStG not applied: without a purchase date or year of construction, the four-year period can’t be checked.
fehlt.sonderafa_abgelaufen: Special depreciation under Section 7b EStG not applied: the {{jahre}}-year eligibility period has ended.
fehlt.sonderafa_spaeter: Special depreciation under Section 7b EStG not applied: the acquisition is after the year under review.

steuer_cockpit.title: Tax cockpit & value forecast
steuer_cockpit.info: Calculated from purchase price, loan contract (accepted offer) and {{afaType}}. Deductible expenses = depreciation + interest + non-recoverable service charges.
steuer_cockpit.locked_missing_all: This will be unlocked as soon as your contact person at OS Immobilien has added the financing offer, the loan agreement and the purchase price.
steuer_cockpit.locked_missing_docs: This will be unlocked as soon as your contact person at OS Immobilien has released the final financing offer and the loan agreement.
steuer_cockpit.locked_missing_price: As soon as your contact person at OS Immobilien adds the purchase price to this investment, you’ll see your real tax and value development figures here.
steuer_cockpit.tax_rate_tooltip: Auto suggestion from your self-disclosure (gross annual income{{splitting}}: {{brutto}} → taxable income ≈ {{zve}}). You can override the rate at any time, and we save it permanently.
steuer_cockpit.tax_rate_tooltip_zve: Auto suggestion from your self-disclosure (taxable income{{splitting}}: {{zve}}). You can override the rate at any time, and we save it permanently.
steuer_cockpit.suggestion_hint: Suggestion from your self-disclosure, adjustable at any time.
steuer_cockpit.afa_san_text: . Renovation depreciation under Section 7h/i EStG: {{san}} ({{sanrate}}% of {{cost}}, year {{sanjahr}})
steuer_cockpit.werbungskosten_info: Depreciation: {{afa}} + interest year 1: {{zinsen}} + non-recoverable service charges: {{hg}} = {{sum}}. Rental income p.a.: {{miete}}.
steuer_cockpit.loss_info: Rental income {{miete}} − deductible expenses {{wk}} = {{loss}}. A negative value reduces your taxable income.
steuer_cockpit.saving_info: Loss {{loss}} × marginal rate {{rate}} % = {{saving}} per year. Note: excludes solidarity surcharge and church tax, so the actual refund may differ slightly.
steuer_cockpit.forecast_disclaimer: ⚠️ Forecast, not a guaranteed return. Value and rents may differ. The default assumption of 2% p.a. is a long-term reference value for sought-after locations.
steuer_cockpit.afa_denkmal_hint: Increased depreciation under Section 7h/i EStG: 9% in years 1 to 8, then 7% in years 9 to 12. Applied: year {{year}} at {{rate}}%.
steuer_cockpit.afa_denkmal_abgelaufen: Increased depreciation under § 7h/i EStG: the 12-year period has expired, the renovation share is no longer depreciated.
steuer_cockpit.afa_regulaer_hint: There is no certificate under Section 7h/i on file. The renovation costs of {{cost}} therefore increase the regular depreciation base and are depreciated at {{rate}}%.
steuer_cockpit.afa_basis_hint: Basis: purchase price {{kp}} + incidental purchase costs {{nk}}, of which {{share}}% is the building share.
steuer_cockpit.werbungskosten_stufe2: Not yet including property tax, insurance and management fees, these items will follow in a later stage.
steuer_cockpit.rent_missing_info: Without the annual rent, the tax result cannot be calculated. Please ask your contact person at OS Immobilien to add the rental income.
steuer_cockpit.tax_effect_info: Difference method under Section 32a EStG, {{year}} tariff. Your taxable income is derived from your self-disclosure (Selbstauskunft): gross {{brutto}} times 0.7 gives roughly {{zve}}. Result {{result}}, effective tax rate {{eff}}% (marginal tax rate {{rate}}%), effect {{effect}} per year. Excludes solidarity surcharge and church tax.

tfa.title: Two-factor sign-in
tfa.sub: In addition to your password, the portal asks for a code from an app on your phone when you sign in. That way nobody can get into your account just by knowing your password. Whether you turn it on is up to you.
tfa.need_app: Your smartphone with an authenticator app, for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator. The apps are free.
tfa.need_steps: How it works: scan the QR code, enter the 6-digit code and save your recovery codes. It takes about two minutes.
tfa.need_login: After that, every time you sign in, the portal asks for the current code from the app after your password.
tfa.on_text: When you sign in, the portal asks for a code from your app after your password.
tfa.off_text: You sign in with your password only.

tfa.codes_text: If you ever don't have your phone to hand, one of these codes still gets you into the portal. You'll only see them now. Save them in a password manager, or download them and keep them somewhere safe. Each code works once.
tfa.disable_text: For your security, you need the current code from your authenticator app to do this. After that you sign in with your password only, and your recovery codes stop working.

buehne.titel: Your access to property and sales.
buehne.text: Customers follow their investment from the first conversation through to handover. Partners manage leads, properties and deals. All in one place.

zugang.wechsel_kunde: Would you rather work with us?
zugang.wechsel_partner: Interested in a property investment yourself?

kunde.titel: I'm interested in a property investment.
kunde.absatz_1: You're considering whether a let freehold flat is right for you. It doesn't start with an offer but with a conversation: free of charge, by video, around 30 minutes.
kunde.absatz_2: We look at what you have in mind and work through a real property to show what it means for you each month. Every assumption behind a figure is shown openly.
kunde.entfaellt_text: You don't set anything up yourself here. You'll get your access to the customer portal from us as soon as we're working together.
kunde.danach: Leave your details briefly and we'll get back to you within one working day with suggested times.

partner.titel: I'd like to become a sales partner.
partner.absatz_1: You sell investment properties, or you'd like to start. We provide the properties, the calculation, the financing and the entire process through to the notary. You lead the conversations.
partner.absatz_2: Here too, access doesn't come from registering but from getting to know each other. Only when both sides are a good fit do we set you up in the CRM.
partner.entfaellt_text: We don't sell you a way in. What you bring is time for training and a willingness to lead conversations.
partner.danach: The partner page covers earnings, the process and the most common questions. You can apply directly there.

hinweis.mehrere_worte: Use several words and avoid common phrases.
hinweis.laenge_statt_zeichen: Length matters more than special characters.
hinweis.weiteres_wort: Add one or two uncommon words.
hinweis.tastaturreihe: Rows of keys are easy to guess.
hinweis.tastaturmuster: Short keyboard patterns are easy to guess.
hinweis.wiederholung: Repeats like "aaa" are easy to guess.
hinweis.sequenz: Sequences like abc or 6543 aren't secure.
hinweis.eigene_jahre: Avoid years that are associated with you.
hinweis.top_zehn: One of the 10 most common passwords. Not allowed.
hinweis.top_hundert: One of the 100 most common passwords. Not allowed.
hinweis.sehr_verbreitet: A very common password. Not allowed.
hinweis.aehnlich_verbreitet: Similar to a commonly used password.
hinweis.einzelnes_wort: A single word is easy to guess.
hinweis.namen_allein: First names and surnames on their own aren't secure.
hinweis.persoenliche_angaben: Personal details such as your name or email address don't belong in a password.
hinweis.nur_grossbuchstaben: All capitals are about as easy to guess as all lower case.
hinweis.umgekehrt: Reversed words are hardly more secure.
hinweis.ersetzungen: Substitutions like @ for a don't help much.
hinweis.geleakt: This password has appeared in a data breach on the internet.
hinweis.geleakt_anderswo: If you use this password elsewhere, change it there.
